tools.name: film.info
tools.description: Probe a media file in your workspace (MP4/MOV, Matroska/WebM, MXF, MPEG TS/PS, Ogg, WAV or a still image): container, video and audio streams, duration in ms, timecode and size. Reads only; offline, pure-Rust codecs. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named.

tools.name: film.project.info
tools.description: Open a FilmCraft project (.fcproj) in your workspace headlessly and inspect it: its bins and items, and the active sequence when it has one. Media the project points at outside your workspace stay offline. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace (see film.info).

tools.name: film.frame
tools.description: Render the frame at `at_ms` (default 0) of a video in your workspace through the engine's program renderer, written as a PNG to `out` with its longest edge at most `max_side` pixels (default 1024). Both paths are relative to your workspace (see film.info); nothing is written outside it, and a file already at `out` is never replaced: choose a new name.

tools.name: film.export
tools.description: Transcode the range `start_ms` to `end_ms` (default the whole clip, at most 5 minutes per call) of a media file in your workspace with the engine's own encoders: H.264+AAC MP4 (h264), ProRes MOV (prores), WAV or GIF, chosen by `format` or else by the extension of `out`; `audio` false drops the sound. Offline. Both paths are relative to your workspace (see film.info); nothing is written outside it, and a file already at `out` is never replaced: choose a new name.
